commits.messageBody:
Load and offline end a running call from granted durS when it is a finite
value above 0, otherwise tc_ability_s. When tc combo_boost_duration_s is
present, granted is capped at max(tc_ability_s, that value). activeS is
clamped to [0, granted], effect_s is granted - activeS, and both activeS
and durS are cleared. No SAVE_VERSION bump.

Co-authored-by: Korshunov Vadim <PrincipalLewis@users.noreply.github.com>

Per-worker pause skips wage, collect, sell, and price or demand work, recovers energy at rest_recovery_mult, and starts a 45s Market Hand call lockout on resume. The lockout counts down in sim time and stays frozen across offline and hidden gaps of 60s. Flag off is a no-op. SAVE_VERSION stays 6.

AbilityState.durS (Architect #112) is what m5Load and m5Offline use for effect_s, so 20s left of a 45s combo reports 25 rather than tc_ability_s minus the leftover. durS is stripped with activeS when the call ends and is kept on the ability entry until then.

Co-authored-by: Korshunov Vadim <PrincipalLewis@users.noreply.github.com>
